name: SCIWORA
definition: Traumatic spinal cord injury with neurological deficit despite absence of fracture or dislocation on initial radiographs or CT.

investigations.principle: MRI is essential when neurological deficit persists despite normal CT/radiographs.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, postoperative, infection, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific pathway.

amber: Normal radiographs do not exclude serious cord injury.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Emergency spinal cord care takes priority.

patientEducation.summary: Traumatic spinal cord injury with neurological deficit despite absence of fracture or dislocation on initial radiographs or CT.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, major trauma, unstable fracture/dislocation, sepsis/infection or other listed red flags.
